Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the outline earlier. We're excited to get the working session going. A couple of notes on our side:

- We want the hands-on portion to include a short prompt review (15–20m), followed by routing policy walkthrough (30m) and an end-of-day mini-load test (30m).
- Primary attendees from FinApps: myself (product), Daniel Park (infra), and Samir Rao (security).
- We're on Pacific time. Best windows next week are: Tue 04/13 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 04/14 13:00–15:00 PT.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Provide a test model variant with fallback behavior for the load test, and
2) Share any prework (sample prompts + traffic distribution) we should upload ahead of time?

I'll also attach our traffic snapshot and a short doc describing the evaluation criteria.

Thanks,
Claire

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask and the traffic snapshot. Both suggested windows look workable for us; we prefer Tue 04/13 10:00–12:00 PT so we can get the full hands-on time in. Proposed plan from Redwood:

- 10:00–10:15 PT: Intros & objectives (owner: Sergio)
- 10:15–10:35 PT: Prompt review + quality goals (Laura)
- 10:35–11:10 PT: Routing policy deep-dive (model selection, fallback tiers, region routing) — Monica
- 11:10–11:40 PT: Live configuration exercise + KV/prefix caching demo (Neha)
- 11:40–12:00 PT: Mini load test (steady-state tokens + sudden spike), results and next steps (Sergio)

Prework from our side (attached): "Sergio_Routing_Prework.pdf" — it includes guidance on prompt sets, a short checklist for test accounts, and our recommended model variants (quantized vs float) for early load tests. Can you please:
- Confirm attendees and roles (prod/infra/security)
- Upload the sample prompt file from your snapshot to the shared Drive link below by EOD 04/11
- Indicate if the security team wants to run the load test in a private VPC (we support that, will need network info)

If Tue 04/13 works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook. If you prefer Wed 04/14, we can shift — please let me know by EOD.

If Tue 04/13 stays, we can join the 10:00 PT window but will drop off by 11:45 PT for another commitment.

Thanks,
